name: 胡江
title: AI | MLOps
headline: I'm Hu Jiang.
tagline: AI engineering, MLOps, LLM systems, and data flywheels.
introEnglish: I work on AI infrastructure and MLOps for high-QPS model systems, with hands-on experience across data mining, model training, automated evaluation, inference deployment, and LLM/Agent-driven data distillation. My recent work focuses on multimodal content understanding, preference optimization, synthetic data generation, and production-grade model iteration loops.
introChinese: 我关注 AI 工程化与模型运维，主要经验覆盖数据挖掘、送标、训练、自动化评测、推理部署和数据飞轮闭环。近期工作聚焦多模态内容理解、DPO 偏好优化、LLM 数据蒸馏、Agentic 数据生产与高 QPS 模型上线体系。
